payout_quote: Election Worker Pay — Election Day: Clerk: $415 plus $25 for Monday set-up (Required) for a total of $440; Assistant Clerk: $315 plus $25 for Monday set-up (Required) for a total of $340; VST: $330 plus $25 for Monday set-up (Required) for a total of $355; Quality Assurance Forms Inspector: $275; Inspector: $255; Deputy: $240. Early Voting Hourly Rate — Site Supervisor: $20/hour; Assistant Site Supervisor: $18/hour; Quality Assurance Forms Inspector: $17/hour; Inspector: $16/hour; Site Deputy: $16/hour. Note: Rate of pay includes training, Monday set-up (if required), and Election Day.
steps: Be a registered or pre-registered voter in Palm Beach County; able to read, write, and speak English.
Apply through the Election Worker Portal at votepalmbeach.gov.
Complete all required training and assessments prior to each election (training classes are two to six hours depending on position).
Arrive at 5:30 am on Election Day and work a 14-hour day (Deputy, Inspector, or Quality Assurance Forms Inspector - roles with no Monday set-up requirement).
catches: Election-period work only; you may not be assigned to work each election.
Must complete required training before each election (2-6 hours, included in the rate).
This route covers Deputy, Inspector, and QA Forms Inspector only - Clerk, Assistant Clerk, and VST roles are excluded because their required Monday set-up duration is unstated.
FRS pension: if you retired from an FRS employer less than six months ago, working may jeopardize your FRS pension.
Must have reliable transportation, email, computer/internet access; lift up to 20 lbs; complete I-9/E-Verify and payroll direct-deposit documentation.
Serve at the will of the Supervisor of Elections - not assigned every election or the same precinct/position.
biggest_catch: Framed on Deputy/Inspector/QA Forms Inspector ($240-$275) only - Clerk-class roles are excluded because their required Monday set-up has no stated duration; you may not be assigned every election.
eligibility: Registered or pre-registered voter in Palm Beach County; read/write/speak English; complete training and assessments; I-9/E-Verify.
timing: Direct-deposit payroll documentation required; exact pay date not stated on the official pages.
